numeric_contract: All native float-valued capture words, including F high/low, projected-state high/low, accepted state, direction, and parameters, are rounded to float32 and widened exactly. The independent replay sums each high+low pair in FP64, including a two-word decomposition of the exact realized endpoint direction; exact-endpoint stress differences remain unrounded FP64.
limits: Capture JSON exposes directional tangent only, not the full 9x9 native tangent; exact realized-pair derivative is compared with independent tangent, not native tangent transformed to a new direction.
Absolute deterministic discrepancies are evaluator error envelopes, not stochastic/repeatability noise floors.
Near-yield or branch-crossing endpoint pairs are not admissible smooth-derivative tests.
No physical grade calibration, box qualification, or convergence claim.
